source.title: People v Allen (2014 NY Slip Op 08222)

captionLines: The People of the State of New York, Respondent,

qualifierLines: {**24 NY3d at 444} OPINION OF THE COURT

The Appellate Division unanimously modified the judgment of conviction, as a matter of discretion in the interest of justice, by directing that all the terms of imprisonment run concurrently with each other, and as so modified, affirmed, holding that: (1) although the trial court erred in denying defendant's motion to suppress the lineup identification, the error was harmless; (2) the trial court properly refused to allow defendant to introduce extrinsic evidence on a collateral matter to impeach{**24 NY3d at 448} the credibility of a witness; and (3) the duplicity argument was unpreserved (105 AD3d 754 [2d Dept 2013]).
